# Policy Rate Atlas

> Central bank policy rates for seven economies (India, United States, euro area, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and Brazil): every change since 2000, checked against official sources, with the decisions, cycles and gaps behind them. Independent: not affiliated with, authorised by or endorsed by any central bank.

The figures on every page come from the open JSON and CSV API at https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/api/v1/, which is the primary machine interface. Use it for numbers, and cite the page or release you used.

## Pages
- [Home: India, policy repo rate](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/): the default country page.
- [World view](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/world/): the seven banks side by side.
- [United States: federal funds target](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/us/)
- [Euro area: deposit facility rate](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/ea/)
- [United Kingdom: Bank Rate](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/gb/)
- [Canada: overnight rate target](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/ca/)
- [Australia: cash rate target](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/au/)
- [Brazil: Selic target](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/br/)
- [Privacy](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/privacy/): what is counted, and how to switch it off.
- [Design system](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/design/): the colours, type, components and rules the site is built from.

## Data
- [Countries](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/api/v1/countries.json): every bank, its current level and its release.
- [Latest levels](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/api/v1/latest.json): the level in force at each bank.
- [Schedule](https://rates.ashwingopalsamy.in/api/v1/schedule.json): announced decision times.
- Per bank, with codes in, us, ea, gb, ca, au and br: `/api/v1/countries/{code}.json` (current release), `/api/v1/countries/{code}/series.csv` (one row per change) and `/api/v1/countries/{code}/decisions.csv` (one row per decision).
- Immutable, content-addressed releases: `/api/v1/releases/{CODE}/{hash}.json`.
- The same releases on Hugging Face, in Parquet, CSV and JSONL: [central-bank-policy-rates](https://huggingface.co/datasets/ashwingopalsamy/central-bank-policy-rates).
